# <key> | <n> | <IEEE-754 bits of each value, hex>
# Updated (D-017.9, approved): the 63 `analytic` records of vonmises, hill48 and cpb06 at a null
# equivalent stress (zero, hydrostatic and, for cpb06 sets 1, 5 and 6, s16): the gradient and the
# Hessian are 0 instead of NaN (0/0). No other record changed.
# Updated (D-017.10c, approved): cpb06 evaluates Phi on the principal values scaled by the power of
# two of max |lambda|; only `cpb06 | set 6 | s32 | base numeric` changed (1 ulp of stress_eq at a
# perturbed point, amplified by the finite difference: max change 1.8e-12 relative to the largest
# component). No analytic record of cpb06 changed.
# Updated (D-017.10d, approved): von Mises Hessian written with n = dev/seq,
# (9/(4 seq)) n (x) n instead of (9/(4 seq**3)) s (x) s: the 17 `vonmises | sNN | analytic` records
# s09-s13, s16, s17, s19, s22, s25, s27, s28, s30, s32-s34, s37 changed by rounding (max 1.7e-16
# relative to the largest component). No other record changed.
# Updated (D-017.9, approved; migration of cpb06ex2 and yld2004): the 63 records at a null
# equivalent stress (cpb06ex2: 35 `analytic`, zero and hydrostatic states of every set; yld2004: 14
# `analytic` and 14 `stressEq_and_derivatives`, the zero tensor of every set and the hydrostatic
# states where Sigma' and Sigma'' vanish, sets 1 and 3): the gradient and the Hessian are 0 instead
# of NaN (0/0).
# Updated (D-017.10c, approved): cpb06ex2 and yld2004 evaluate the powers on the principal values
# scaled by the power of two of max |lambda|. The scaling is exact but the real power (pow) is not
# exactly homogeneous in floating point for every a (a = 5, 12 and 6 here), so 77 records changed
# by rounding: cpb06ex2 sets 1-2, 27 `analytic`; yld2004 sets 3-4, 25 `analytic` and the same 25
# `stressEq_and_derivatives` (max 1.0e-14 relative to the largest component, cpb06ex2 | set 1 | s24,
# a Hessian component at an equibiaxial state of magnitude 1e-3; 2.8e-15 in yld2004; stress_eq
# <= 12 ulp (<= 2.4e-15 relative)), and 89 `base numeric` records (cpb06ex2 59, yld2004 30: 1 ulp of stress_eq at the
# perturbed points amplified by the finite differences, max 9.3e-9). No other record changed.
# Updated (D-017.11d, approved): Drucker-Prager Hessian in the stable form (n = S/q, coefficients
# O(1/q), no q**3 or q**4): the 94 `druckerprager | set N | sNN | analytic` records off the
# hydrostatic axis changed by rounding in the Hessian components only (max 6.7e-16 relative to the
# largest component). No other record changed.
# Removed (D-018.8): the 892 `base numeric` records (finite-difference procedures of the OO base
# Base_yield_critera, retired with it, D-018.18f) and the 15 `constructor` records of CPB06 (6),
# CPB06ex2 (5) and Yld2004 (4), whose derived parameters are private in the kernel types (D-018.18j).
# The other records are reproduced bit for bit by the kernel API (test_yield_golden.fypp).
